measured_by: verify-alternatives (adversarial re-check of the non-rewrite options)
box: Apple M4 Pro, 12 logical cores, load average 1.9-4.9 throughout; nothing else of mine running
slice: rebuild.pipeline.table.build_tables, the REAL kernel, 8 of 18 runes (keep=5), all six acceptance configurations, out_dir=None trace_store=None

equivalence.method: blake2b-128 over every rule row, reachable cell, window key, treaty row and fired-provenance pointer of each built table (raw/perf2/freethreaded/kernel.py:checksum)
equivalence.note: these six also equal the freethreaded slice s own reference_checksums in env.json, so the two slices cross-confirm

repo_kernel_tests.command: pytest rebuild/test_settle.py rebuild/test_table.py rebuild/test_trace_memo.py rebuild/test_specificity.py -n auto --dist worksteal
repo_kernel_tests.why_it_matters: test_trace_memo exercises build_tables with a real persisted TraceStore AND a TraceShare, which is the one place the candidates memo s fired-pointer replay could have diverged

compiler_flags.mypyc: mypyc --explicit-package-bases, setuptools default + -O3 -g1 (no PGO/LTO/-march=native); one extra annotation widening beyond the shipped five (fired: list[Provenance] -> list) was needed to compile the levered source
compiler_flags.pypy: no compilation; PEP 758 except-clauses parenthesized by raw/perf2/compilers/patch_pep758.py (exact rewrite)

dead_code_defence: every arm materializes the full DecisionTable and TreatyTable and folds every rule, cell, window, treaty row and provenance pointer into a printed digest; an elided computation prints a different digest
